title: गुणस्तरीय शिक्षा प्रवद्र्धनका लागि आधारभुत विद्यालयमा बालमैत्री कक्षा व्यवस्थापन
nepali: बालमैत्री विद्यालय स्थापना गर्ने नेपाल सरकारको नीतिअनुुसार बालमैत्री विद्यालयमा सञ्चालन गरिने सिकाइ क्रियाकलाप सो अनुकुल भएनभएको पहिचान गर्न अति जरुरी भएको हुँदा यो अध्ययन गरिएको हो । विद्यालयमा बालमैत्री कक्षाकोठा व्यवस्थापन तथा सिकाइ क्रियाकलापको अवस्था पहिचान गर्नु यस अध्ययनको प्रमुख उद्देश्य रहेको छ । यस अध्ययनमा गुणात्मक तरिकाले उद्देश्यमूलक नमूना छनोट प्रक्रियालाई अपनाइ भक्तपुर जिल्लामा सञ्चालित बालमैत्री विद्यालयका नमूना छनोटमा परेका विद्यालयका प्रधानाध्यापक, शिक्षक, विद्यालय व्यवस्थापन समितिका अध्यक्ष एवम् विद्यार्थीहरूसँग अन्तर्वार्ता, छलफल, प्रश्नावलीका माध्यमबाट सूचनाहरू लिइएको छ । हालसम्म बालमैत्री विद्यालयको सन्दर्भमा सैद्धान्तिक स्पष्टता विद्यालयहरूमा प्राप्त भैनसकेको अवस्था भए तापनि बालकेन्द्रित शिक्षण पद्धति अपनाएर सक्रिय सिकाइ, दण्डरहीत सिकाइ, विद्यार्थी सहभागिता, समावेशीकरण र विद्यालयमा रमाइलो शिक्षण वातावरण सिर्जनामा भने विद्यालयहरू लागि परेको अवस्था पाइयो । बालमैत्री विद्यालयमा शिक्षक पथ प्रदर्शक तथा निर्देशकको रूपमा रहेर विद्यालयहरूलाई स्व–सिकाइका लागि उपयुक्त रमाइलो वातावरण सिर्जना गर्न कार्यरत रहनु पर्ने र खेलको माध्यमबाट सिकाइ, बालगीत, कविता तथा कथाको प्रयोग, अभिनय तथा नाटकीकरण, परियोजना कार्य, क्षेत्र भ्रमण र सिर्जनात्मक कार्यजस्ता कक्षा कार्य सञ्चालन गर्नुको साथै विद्यालयमा योजनाबद्ध अतिरिक्त क्रियाकलाप सञ्चालन, मनोवैज्ञानिक छात्रवृत्तिको व्यवस्था, शान्ति शिक्षाको व्यवस्था, विना डर सिक्ने अवस्थाको सिर्जना गरेर वास्तविक र अर्थपूर्ण सिकाइको लागि विद्यालयहरू लागिपर्नु पर्ने देखिन्छ । विद्यालयमा बालमैत्री वातावरण सिर्जना गर्न केन्द्रदेखि विद्यालय तहसम्म सबै पक्ष समन्वयात्मक रूपमा योजनाबद्ध कार्यमा जुट्न आवश्यक देखिन्छ र विद्य।लयलाई बालबालिकाहरूको आफ्नै घरको रूपमा विकास गराउनु पर्ने देखिन्छ।
american_english: In accordance with the Government of Nepal's policy of establishing child-friendly schools, this study has been conducted because it has become extremely necessary to identify whether the learning activities run in child-friendly schools are suited to that or not. The main objective of this study is to identify the condition of child-friendly classroom management and learning activities in schools. In this study, adopting a qualitative approach and a purposive sampling procedure, information has been taken from the principals, teachers, chairpersons of the school management committees and students of the schools that fell into the sample among the child-friendly schools run in Bhaktapur district, through interviews, discussions and questionnaires. Although, up to now, theoretical clarity about child-friendly schools has not yet been achieved in schools, schools were nonetheless found to have taken up the child-centered teaching method and created active learning, punishment-free learning, student participation, inclusiveness and a pleasant teaching environment. In a child-friendly school, it is seen that teachers should remain as guides and directors, working to create a suitable and pleasant environment for self-learning; that, along with learning through play, they should carry out classroom activities such as the use of children's songs, poems and stories, acting and dramatization, project work, field visits and creative work; and that, along with conducting planned extra-curricular activities in the school, arranging psychological scholarships, arranging peace education and creating a situation of learning without fear, schools should strive for real and meaningful learning. To create a child-friendly environment in schools, it is seen that all parties from the center to the school level need to join in planned work in a coordinated manner, and that the school needs to be developed as the children's own home.

In this study, adopting a qualitative approach and a purposive sampling procedure, information has been obtained from the head teachers, teachers, chairpersons of the school management committees and pupils of the schools selected in the sample among the child-friendly schools conducted in Bhaktapur district, by means of interviews, discussions and questionnaires. Although, hitherto, theoretical clarity regarding child-friendly schools has not yet been attained in schools, schools were nevertheless found to have adopted the child-centred teaching method and created active learning, punishment-free learning, pupil participation, inclusiveness and a pleasant teaching environment. In a child-friendly school, it is seen that teachers should remain as guides and directors, working to create a suitable and pleasant environment for self-learning; that, together with learning through play, they should conduct classroom activities such as the use of children's songs, poems and stories, acting and dramatisation, project work, field visits and creative work; and that, together with organising planned extra-curricular activities in the school, arranging psychological scholarships, arranging peace education and creating a condition of learning without fear, schools should strive for real and meaningful learning. In order to create a child-friendly environment in schools, it is seen that all parties from the centre down to school level need to join in planned work in a coordinated manner, and that the school needs to be developed as the children's own home.
australian_english: In line with the Government of Nepal's policy of setting up child-friendly schools, this study has been done because it has become absolutely necessary to work out whether the learning activities run in child-friendly schools are up to that or not. The main aim of this study is to work out the state of child-friendly classroom management and learning activities in schools. In this study, taking a qualitative approach with a purposive sampling process, information has been gathered from the principals, teachers, school management committee chairs and students of the schools that ended up in the sample among the child-friendly schools run in Bhaktapur district, by way of interviews, discussions and questionnaires. Although, up to now, theoretical clarity about child-friendly schools has not yet been reached in schools, schools were nonetheless found to have taken up the child-centred teaching method and put in place active learning, punishment-free learning, student participation, inclusiveness and a pleasant teaching environment. In a child-friendly school, it is seen that teachers should stay in the role of guide and director, working to set up a suitable and pleasant environment for self-learning; that, along with learning through play, they should run classroom activities such as using children's songs, poems and stories, acting and dramatisation, project work, field trips and creative work; and that, along with running planned extra-curricular activities at the school, arranging psychological scholarships, arranging peace education and creating a situation where students can learn without fear, schools should be putting in the effort for real and meaningful learning. To create a child-friendly environment in schools, it is seen that everyone from the centre right through to school level needs to get stuck into planned work in a coordinated way, and that the school needs to be developed as the children's own home.
informal_english: Nepal's government has a policy of setting up child-friendly schools, and since it's become really important to figure out whether the learning activities being run in these child-friendly schools actually fit that policy or not, this study was done. The main aim here is to figure out what shape child-friendly classroom management and learning activities are in at the schools. For this study, we went with a qualitative approach and picked the sample on purpose, and got information from the principals, teachers, school management committee chairs and students at the sampled schools among the child-friendly ones in Bhaktapur district — through interviews, discussions and questionnaires. Up to now, schools haven't really got theoretical clarity on what a child-friendly school is, but the study did find that schools have taken up child-centred teaching and have got active learning, learning without punishment, student participation, inclusiveness and a nicer, more enjoyable teaching environment going. In a child-friendly school, teachers are meant to stay in the role of guide and director, working to create a suitable, pleasant environment for kids to learn on their own; and schools are meant to run classroom activities like learning through play, using children's songs, poems and stories, acting and dramatisation, project work, field trips and creative work, plus planned extra-curricular activities, psychological scholarships, peace education, and a situation where kids can learn without being scared — all of that so that the learning is real and actually means something. To create a child-friendly environment, it looks like everyone from the centre down to the school level needs to get on board with planned, coordinated work, and the school needs to be developed into the kids' own home.
translator_notes: Abstract translated sentence by sentence in source order; 'child-friendly' kept as the established rendering of 'balmaitri'; 'psychological scholarship' rendered literally from 'manobaigyanik chhatravritti' as the source gives no further detail.
